subject: same area for all violins independent of facets

messages.subject: same area for all violins independent of facets
parts:
Hello everyone,

I want to create a plot for three different factors where all violins have the same area. But using facet_grid(. ~ C) seems to force the violins within each facet (i.e. just those within a level of factor C) to have the same area. How can I change the scaling within the facets so that  all the violins have the same area? Please note that I asked the question on stackoverflow and this answer does what I want. But is there no way to do this with geom_violin() and facet_grid()? 

library(ggplot2)

d <- data.frame(value = c(906, 1013, 1109, 876, 747, 759, 876, 1358, 739, 
                          1086, 807, 954, 1586, 762, 1353, 1221, 976, 1002, 
                          1129, 943, 1270, 1126, 853, 950, 677, 696, 681, 
                          615, 736, 595, 590, 618, 524, 1014, 515, 645, 860, 
                          874, 934, 728, 1078, 659, 1024, 786, 821, 541,
                          681, 744),
                A = gl(2, 12, 48),
                B = gl(2, 6, 48),
                C = gl(2, 24))

ggplot(d, aes(x = A, y = value, fill = B)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, scale = "area") +
  facet_grid(. ~ C)
